title: Pixabay Image Scraper
description: Collect image metadata from Pixabay image search results. Search by keyword, add a location context, or provide a Pixabay image search URL.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search term such as nature, sunset, or city skyline. Used when no URL is supplied.

location.title: Location context
location.description: Optional place name added to the keyword search phrase, for example Tokyo or Pakistan. Ignored when a URL is supplied.

url.title: Pixabay search URL
url.description: Full Pixabay image search URL, for example https://pixabay.com/images/search/nature/. Takes priority over keyword and location. Individual image pages are not supported.

startUrl.title: Alternate search URL
startUrl.description: Alternate full Pixabay image search URL for existing workflows. Takes priority over url.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of images
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of unique images to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of result pages to process. Each page contains about 100 images.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. The Actor works without a proxy, and Apify Proxy requires a cloud run.
